_comment: Privacy notice (GDPR Art. 13 and 14) rendered by site/build.py at /privacy/ and /zh/privacy/. Placeholders: {brand} {maintainer} {issues} {remove} {about}. Links: [text](url). A section or paragraph ({"t": text, "when" or "unless": feature}) with "when" is shown only while that feature is on, with "unless" only while it is off, and build.py refuses to build when a feature is on without its section. Change "updated" whenever the text changes.

p: {brand} is a private, non-commercial project run by {maintainer}, who is responsible for the processing described here (the controller under the GDPR).

Contact: [open an issue on GitHub]({issues}). If your request involves personal details you do not want to make public, open an issue that only says you have a private request, and we will agree on a private channel there.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. When you open a page, GitHub (GitHub B.V., Netherlands, and GitHub, Inc., USA) processes your IP address and the usual request data, such as the page requested, the time and your browser, in order to deliver the page. GitHub states that it logs visitors' IP addresses for security purposes. {brand} has no access to these logs.

Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, our legitimate interest in delivering the site securely. GitHub may transfer data to the USA. It is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and also uses the EU standard contractual clauses. Details: [GitHub's privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).
The site sets no cookies and runs no analytics or tracking. Fonts, scripts and data all come from this site. Nothing is loaded from other servers, and there are no ads or social media embeds.

If you switch the language on the front page, the choice is saved in your browser's local storage under the key openshelf-lang. It stays on your device and is never sent anywhere. Storing it is strictly necessary for the function you asked for (§ 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG). You can delete it in your browser settings at any time.
Links to posts take you to other websites, where their own privacy policies apply.

sections.h: Cookies and storage in your browser
p: The site sets no cookies. Fonts, scripts and data all come from this site. The only other server it talks to is our own statistics and voting server, described below. There are no ads or social media embeds.

If you switch the language on the front page, the choice is saved in your browser's local storage under the key openshelf-lang. It stays on your device. Storing it is strictly necessary for the function you asked for (§ 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG). You can delete it in your browser settings at any time.
Links to posts take you to other websites, where their own privacy policies apply.

We count page views and clicks to learn which posts are read and to improve the site. A small script on the front page sends the following to our server: the page and its language, the website you came from (only its host name, such as news.ycombinator.com), and what you do on the page, for example which post you open and its position in the list, which view, filter or topic you choose, and what you search for. Events from one page load share a random number, which is not stored in your browser.

Your IP address and browser identification (user agent) reach the server with every request. They are not stored. They are only used, together with a secret value and the current date, to compute a short code that lets us count how many different visitors there were on that day. The same visitor cannot be recognised on another day. Cloudflare derives the country from the IP address, and we store the country. Bots are not counted.
If your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, the script sends nothing. Raw records are deleted after 90 days.

The server is a Cloudflare Worker. Cloudflare, Inc. (USA) processes the data on our behalf under its data processing addendum, and the database is located in Western Europe. Cloudflare is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, our interest in knowing how the site is used, in a way that does not identify visitors.

You can vote on posts without an account. When you vote for the first time, your browser stores a random code under the key openshelf-voter, and your votes under openshelf-votes, in local storage. This lets you change or take back a vote and keeps you from being counted twice. Nothing is stored before you vote (§ 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG).

Our server stores the post, your vote, a scrambled form of the random code and the date. To limit abuse, it also stores a code computed from your IP address and the date, which allows only a few votes per network and post each day. This code is erased after one day. Your IP address itself is not stored. Vote totals are shown publicly on the site.

Clicking the same arrow again takes your vote back and deletes it from the server. Otherwise votes are kept. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, our interest in letting readers show which posts they find useful, with protection against manipulation.

Submissions and removal requests are made through GitHub issues. Anything you write in an issue is public, and GitHub's privacy statement applies. We use what you send only to handle your request. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

{brand} lists research posts that are publicly available on websites. They are found through the websites' own feeds, [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/) (through the Algolia search API) and [Rogue Scholar](https://rogue-scholar.org/). Our crawler identifies itself as openshelf-crawler and links to the [About page]({about}).

For each post we store its title, address, website, date and topic, short summaries in English and Chinese, discussion counts from Hacker News, and which other websites link to it. We do not collect authors' names separately, but a name can appear in a web address, a title or a summary. We also keep a list of addresses already checked, so that no post is checked twice. Entries are kept until their removal is requested.

To decide whether a post is research and to write the summaries, the public text of the post (its description and roughly the first 320 words, and for responses the text around the link) is sent to language models through OpenRouter (OpenRouter, Inc., USA). OpenRouter passes it on to model providers that may be located outside the EU, for example in the USA or China. Only this public text is sent, never anything about visitors.

Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The interest is to make research published on personal websites easier to find, and to show how posts answer each other. Only what the authors have published themselves is used, and they can object at any time.

To object or to have a post removed, [send a removal request]({remove}). Once we have processed it, the post is deleted from the data and the site. If you ask, we also stop collecting from your whole website. Earlier versions of the data remain in the history of the public repository. Tell us if you want them removed there as well.

You have the right of access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18) and data portability (Art. 20), and the right to object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21). To use them, see the contact above.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR), in particular in the EU member state where you live or work.
{brand} 是由 {maintainer} 运营的个人非商业项目，本页所述的数据处理由其负责（即 GDPR 所称的控制者）。
联系方式：[在 GitHub 上提交 issue]({issues})。如果你的请求涉及不想公开的个人信息，请提交一个只写明“有私人请求”、不含细节的 issue，我们会在那里商定私下联系的方式。
本站托管在 GitHub Pages 上。你打开页面时，GitHub（荷兰的 GitHub B.V. 和美国的 GitHub, Inc.）会处理你的 IP 地址和常规请求信息，例如请求的页面、时间和浏览器，用于把页面发送给你。GitHub 说明它会出于安全目的记录访问者的 IP 地址。{brand} 看不到这些日志。

法律依据：GDPR 第 6 条第 1 款 f 项，即安全提供网站的正当利益。GitHub 可能把数据传输到美国。它已通过欧盟-美国数据隐私框架（EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework）认证，并同时使用欧盟标准合同条款。详见 [GitHub 隐私声明](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement)。
本站不设置 Cookie，也不运行任何统计或追踪。字体、脚本和数据都来自本站，不从其他服务器加载任何内容，也没有广告和社交媒体插件。
如果你在首页切换语言，这个选择会保存在浏览器的本地存储里，键名是 openshelf-lang。它只留在你的设备上，不会发送到任何地方。保存它是提供你所要求的功能所必需的（德国 TDDDG 第 25 条第 2 款第 2 项）。你可以随时在浏览器设置里删除它。
文章链接会带你去其他网站，那里适用各自的隐私政策。
本站不设置 Cookie。字体、脚本和数据都来自本站。除此之外，网页只会连接我们自己的统计与投票服务器，详见下文。本站没有广告和社交媒体插件。
如果你在首页切换语言，这个选择会保存在浏览器的本地存储里，键名是 openshelf-lang。它只留在你的设备上。保存它是提供你所要求的功能所必需的（德国 TDDDG 第 25 条第 2 款第 2 项）。你可以随时在浏览器设置里删除它。
文章链接会带你去其他网站，那里适用各自的隐私政策。
我们统计页面浏览和点击，以了解哪些文章被阅读，并改进网站。首页上的一个小脚本会把以下信息发送到我们的服务器：所在页面和语言；你从哪个网站来，只记录域名，例如 news.ycombinator.com；你在页面上的操作，例如打开了哪篇文章、它在列表里排第几、选择了哪个视图、筛选或主题，以及搜索了什么。同一次页面加载产生的记录共用一个随机数，它不会保存在你的浏览器里。
每次请求都会带上你的 IP 地址和浏览器标识（user agent）。它们不会被保存，只是和一个保密值以及当天日期一起，用来算出一个短代码，以便统计当天有多少个不同的访客。换一天就无法认出同一个访客。Cloudflare 会根据 IP 地址判断国家，我们保存这个国家。机器人不计入统计。
如果你的浏览器发送了 Do Not Track 或 Global Privacy Control 信号，脚本什么都不会发送。原始记录在 90 天后删除。
服务器是一个 Cloudflare Worker。Cloudflare, Inc.（美国）根据其数据处理协议代我们处理这些数据，数据库位于西欧。Cloudflare 已通过欧盟-美国数据隐私框架认证。法律依据：GDPR 第 6 条第 1 款 f 项，即在不识别访客身份的前提下了解网站使用情况的正当利益。
你不需要账号就可以给文章投票。第一次投票时，浏览器的本地存储里会保存一个随机代码（键名 openshelf-voter）和你的投票（键名 openshelf-votes）。这样你可以修改或撤回投票，也不会被重复计算。你投票之前什么都不会保存（德国 TDDDG 第 25 条第 2 款第 2 项）。
我们的服务器保存文章、你的投票、随机代码经过加密变换后的形式，以及日期。为了防止滥用，服务器还会保存一个由你的 IP 地址和日期算出的代码，用来限制同一网络每天对同一篇文章只能投少数几票。这个代码一天后会被清除。你的 IP 地址本身不会被保存。各篇文章的票数在网站上公开显示。
再点一次同一个箭头即可撤回投票，服务器上的记录也会删除。除此之外，投票会一直保留。法律依据：GDPR 第 6 条第 1 款 f 项，即让读者表明哪些文章有用、同时防止操纵的正当利益。
提交网站和删除请求都通过 GitHub issue 进行。你在 issue 里写的内容是公开的，并适用 GitHub 的隐私声明。我们只把你发来的信息用于处理你的请求。法律依据：GDPR 第 6 条第 1 款 f 项。
{brand} 收录公开发布在网站上的研究文章。来源包括各网站自己的订阅源、[Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/)（通过 Algolia 搜索接口）和 [Rogue Scholar](https://rogue-scholar.org/)。我们的爬虫标识为 openshelf-crawler，并附有[关于页]({about})的链接。
每篇文章我们保存标题、网址、网站、日期和主题，中英文简短摘要，Hacker News 上的讨论数，以及有哪些其他网站链接到它。我们不单独收集作者姓名，但姓名可能出现在网址、标题或摘要里。我们还保存一份已检查过的网址清单，避免重复检查同一篇文章。收录的条目会一直保留，直到有人要求删除。
为了判断一篇文章是否属于研究并撰写摘要，文章的公开文字会通过 OpenRouter（OpenRouter, Inc.，美国）发送给语言模型。发送的内容是文章简介和大约前 320 个词，判断回应关系时还包括链接前后的文字。OpenRouter 会再转给模型服务商，它们可能位于欧盟以外，例如美国或中国。发送的只有这些公开文字，不含任何访问者信息。
法律依据：GDPR 第 6 条第 1 款 f 项。目的是让发表在个人网站上的研究更容易被找到，并展示文章之间如何相互回应。我们只使用作者自己公开发布的内容，作者可以随时提出反对。
如需反对或删除，请[提交删除请求]({remove})。我们处理之后，该文章会从数据和网站上删除。如果你要求，我们也会停止收集你整个网站的内容。旧版数据仍留在公开仓库的历史记录里，如需一并删除，请告诉我们。
你有权查阅（GDPR 第 15 条）、更正（第 16 条）、删除（第 17 条）、限制处理（第 18 条）和数据可携（第 20 条），并有权反对基于正当利益的处理（第 21 条）。行使这些权利，请使用上面的联系方式。
你还有权向数据保护监管机构投诉（GDPR 第 77 条），尤其是你居住或工作所在的欧盟成员国的监管机构。
